from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action as written in this document, e.g., '婚姻家庭纠纷', '物权保护纠纷', etc.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
